notes: G3 content bundle: 16 display_name and about claims, one per stored venue.
Every about clause restates an observed_fact or a fields.* claim already in city.json; nothing new is asserted here.
display_name labels follow the measured labels in g1-plan-v1.md (Chrome line-count gate at 1440/1280).
Words that the source pages use promotionally (beautiful, unparalleled, wonderful) are not repeated; the measured facts replace them.
No rates are stated where the store records price as null or unknown; the text says unpublished instead.
